notes: I rewrote the rule: the box lowercases everything, capitalizes only the first character (and only if the string doesn't start with whitespace), and deletes every lowercase `m` that isn't the very first character. This explains the "dropped letter" anomalies (`Example123`→`Exaple123`, `  multiple`→`  ultiple`) while keeping `MiXeD`→`Mixed`, and fixes the over-capitalization of later words.
